summary: test_auto_sol_uses_sol_for_both_review_layers genuinely verifies both conjuncts via direct string equality against independently-declared expected constants; monkeypatch counterexamples for all three sub-requirements (non-Sol spec instructions, auto-spec downgraded to Sol-only, auto-sol upgraded to Fable+Sol) were confirmed to fail the test. Minor note: the _honesty_reviewer_cmd() assertions test a helper method that is not actually wired into _spec_skill (dead code), but this doesn't weaken coverage since the direct instructions-string comparison independently catches every constructed violation.
